All these names refer to the same subject of ‘Ajapā’, the un-articulate repeating of the Ajapāmantra (Haṁsa [Page079-a. mantra: Aham sah2), which is a high form of Advaitic Upāsanā. The texts deal with the same mantra but differ, some slightly an. some more.
